picks.title: The Book of Psalms (1-48) - The Lord Is My Shepherd
picks.summary:
When life hits you with grief, disorientation, or feeling utterly forsaken by God, prose often falls short. The Book of Psalms gives us a sacred language to pour out our hearts—whether we are crying out "Help!", singing "Thanks!", or standing in awe of "Wow!"
Summary: In this inspiring study of Psalms 1–48, we step out of historical analysis and into the sanctuary of the heart. Often called the "Preface of Jesus Christ," the Psalter offers a timeless collection of prayers, hymns, and prophecies that directly mirror the Savior's life, death, and resurrection.
Music as a Lowest and Highest Gear:
picks.reason: Deep engagement with the Psalms as sacred language for suffering and faith.

picks.title: Tables Overturned and Mountains Moved - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E2
picks.summary:
What does your life reveal about whether you are truly following Jesus?
In Matthew 21, Jesus exposes the difference between simply looking religious and living a faith that produces real fruit. Through His entry into Jerusalem, the cleansing of the temple, and the cursing of the fig tree, we see that following Jesus is more than showing up on Sunday or knowing the right answers. 
It is a life of obedience, surrender, and genuine devotion to Him.
📖 Scripture References:
• Matthew 21:1 to 22
• Zechariah 9:9
• John 2:5
• Deuteronomy 14
• Ephesians 4:26 to 27
• James 1:19 to 20
• Exodus 34:6
• Jam
picks.reason: Examines authentic Christian faith beyond ritual and religious appearance.
